common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D cel-shaded anime game six-frame aerial attack sprite atlas. Exactly SIX full-body sprites arranged evenly in THREE columns and TWO rows in chronological reading order. SOLID FLAT CHROMA KEY MAGENTA BACKGROUND, exactly #FF00FF, uniform everywhere around figures. No gradients, no checkerboard, no glow, no shadows, no scenery. This magenta backing is essential for automated extraction. No magenta on any character. No text/grid/effects. Desired canvas 1536x768, six equal 512x384 cells. Match reference costume, ink lines, anatomy proportions and clean detailed shading. Every face and attack faces screen RIGHT. Same head dimensions and torso/limb lengths in all six frames; no character enlargement for attack. Each hypothetical upright body about 225px tall; actual airborne silhouette shorter when tucked. Each figure centered locally near x256 y220 with entire body and weapon comfortably inside cell. All SIX poses unmistakably airborne with feet lifted, NEVER standing or kneeling on a surface. Distinct sequential poses: frame0 tucked anticipation; frame1 winding attack; frame2 full CONTACT; frame3 extended followthrough; frame4 retract; frame5 crouched airborne landing-ready. No duplicate poses.

subjects.naruto: Naruto Uzumaki in original orange jumpsuit with blue shoulder yoke, cream collar, blue forehead protector and blue sandals. Flying forward kick: knees tucked, kicking knee chambers, rightwards extended horizontal contact kick with other leg bent, kick follows through, leg retracts, both knees bend for impending landing.
subjects.kakashi: Kakashi Hatake, silver spiky hair, navy forehead protector covering left eye, navy face mask, olive green flak vest, navy trousers, wraps and sandals. Tucked airborne kunai slash: knees tucked, kunai arm winds back, kunai slashes right at full contact and forward leg kicks right, extended slash followthrough, knife retracts, legs tuck for impending landing.
subjects.sasuke: Original-series Sasuke Uchiha, short spiky black hair, blue high-collar short sleeve shirt, white shorts, white forearm and shin wraps, blue sandals. Twisting aerial kick and kunai: tucked knees, torso winds with kunai drawn back, right leg fully extends RIGHT in twisting contact kick, spinning followthrough, leg retracts, bent knees landing ready.
subjects.sakura: Original-series Sakura Haruno with long pink hair and blue headband, red sleeveless tunic with white circle marks, white shorts, blue sandals. Airborne downward kunai: both knees tucked, right kunai arm winds overhead, full downward-right stabbing contact with bent floating legs, arm follows downward, retracts to guard, knees bend landing ready.
subjects.zabuza: Zabuza Momochi with short black hair, forehead protector, mouth bandages, bare muscular torso, dark straps and dark trousers, gray wraps and sandals. Huge broad silver executioner cleaver with round hole near squared blade tip. Airborne TWO HANDED cleaver swing: tucked knees, heavy blade winds overhead, both arms drive cleaver diagonally down and RIGHT at contact, blade sweeps followthrough, blade retracts, knees bend landing ready.
subjects.haku: Masked Haku in original-series white hunter mask with red markings, dark tied back hair, teal kimono tunic with cream trim and sash, brown underskirt, navy trousers and wrapped shins with sandals. Airborne senbon cast: tucked knees, throwing hand chambers at shoulder, arm fully extends RIGHT at contact releasing exactly three thin senbon needles, followthrough, retract to guard, knees bend landing ready.

suffix: Keep every sprite inside its own evenly divided cell with empty magenta margins. Long cleaver fit within its cell.
selected: Second generation Naruto/Kakashi/Sasuke/Sakura/Zabuza, first generation Haku; all builtin imagegen.
